verdict.rationale: Docs confirm the platform lets ops configure accepted documents by issuing country and document type (docs-8), implying broad multi-country/document-type support, but no published list enumerating supported countries or specific document types (passports, national IDs, licenses, residence permits) is provided in the evidence. Missing for 10: a published country/document-type coverage list, explicit mention of all four document categories, and any breadth metric (e.g., number of countries/documents supported).
